payload.title: Collect the eligible Jev, Kev, and Laya comparison matrix
payload.description:
## Scope

After ordering results and matrix preregistration, freeze development-selected policies for each declared model strategy. Collect matching eligible cells on AG News and Emotion with pinned model artifacts and request budgets; document unsupported conditions and fresh-versus-reused holdout status.

## Definition of done

Results reconcile every model/policy/dataset/budget cell, publish model-by-policy effects and usage/latency, and do not claim broad generalization from two datasets.

## Companion-project coordination

- [Decision-Flywheel](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel/tree/main/project/issues): `decision-flywheel-2f4b891a-1749-5c87-af33-a3ab64c5bf57`.

These are cross-repository references; local Kanbus blocked-by relationships encode prerequisites within this repository.
